purpose: Primary-source evidence for a second audit of alternative public music signals. Candidate URLs do not imply a successful crawl.
method: Read official documentation and ordinary public pages; inspect existing raw HTTP cache locally. Network probes are delegated to the root runner. No credentials, audio downloads, or mutations of external services.

definitions.public_realtime_music_signal: A publicly accessible source whose music activity or update cadence is explicitly evidenced; frequent local polling alone does not establish this.
definitions.personal_activity: History, recommendations, or playback associated with an authenticated user; do not present it as platform-wide listening activity.
definitions.unknown_cadence: Documentation/page does not specify update interval or publication latency. A new release date or current fetch timestamp does not establish a realtime feed.

evidence.facts: API access needs a Bearer access token. Client credentials cover catalog resources; user resources use a user authorization flow. The documentation gives GET /v2/albums/59727856?countryCode=US as a catalog example.
Official embeds expose shareable music entities. Existing local album embed cache contains track title, artist, duration and identifiers; it provides no listening-event timestamps.
My New Arrivals is personalized, contains up to 30 tracks and updates each Friday. This is a weekly personal recommendation feature.
Your History presents a subscriber's personal most-listened tracks, including monthly and yearly collections. It does not establish public platform-wide listening events.

platforms.conclusion_vi: Mẫu đã crawl là catalog. API có xác thực; playlist cá nhân cập nhật tuần và lịch sử cá nhân không chứng minh có luồng thống kê nghe nhạc công khai realtime.

evidence.facts: Every API request requires client_id. The documentation explicitly publishes 709fa152 for testing the read API. OAuth access_token is optional for public review reads; private/user writes have additional requirements.
Tracks supports release-date sorting, single/albumtrack selection and stats. Its current text says stats counters update daily; a future live-analytics promise is not evidence that they already do.
Returns trending track IDs, artist IDs and chart position. The document does not specify refresh cadence.
Public track reviews expose text, title, score, agreement count and dateadded. Supports order=addeddate_desc. No publication/update latency is specified.
Returns active editorial homepage feeds. Each feed has date_start/date_end; types include music entities and news. These are editorial windows rather than listening events.

evidence.facts: Current Napster offers AI-generated music and creation tools. Its official web app is app.napster.com.
Official announcement dated 2026-01-28 describes the new app as AI-generated entertainment and states that it has no traditional record-label catalog.
Current API reference covers agents, AI companions, connections, sessions and transcripts, not a traditional music chart/catalog API. Base URL is companion-api.napster.com and endpoints use /public.
Every current Napster API request requires X-Api-Key. Missing, expired or invalid keys yield 401. Resources are scoped to an organization and project.
Documents GET /public/companions/napster-stock for stock AI companions. It is not a feed of music listening, tracks or public music comments.

candidates.signal: Ordinary official web-app entry; inspect any music catalog metadata actually returned
Current documented API access-boundary check; AI companions, not music records
candidates.cadence: Not applicable to music audience activity
candidates.probe_status: not_probed; AI companion API is irrelevant to music activity

platforms.conclusion_vi: Napster hiện đổi sản phẩm sang nội dung AI. API mới có realtime kết nối AI nhưng không phải luồng lượt nghe nhạc công khai. Không dùng catalog/API nhạc cũ để suy ra khả năng hiện tại.

evidence.facts: The official Amazon Music developer portal states that the Web API is in closed beta.
V2 uses api.music.amazon.com under /v2. Requests require OAuth Bearer and x-api-key set to the LWA Security Profile ID. Access is limited to approved developers.
GET /v2/tracks/top returns popular catalog tracks ordered by popularity and requires music::catalog. Refresh interval and aggregation window are not specified in this page.
Recently Played is /v2/views/recent and needs music::history. It is user history. Catalog views use music::catalog and library views use music::library:read.
V1 top tracks are explicitly personalized from the current user's listening history; do not equate that endpoint with a global popularity chart.

existing_cache.signal: Public playlist-page response; first audit did not record music rows

candidates.signal: Documented popular catalog tracks API; an unauthenticated request can establish access restriction
candidates.auth: Approved beta access, OAuth Bearer and x-api-key; music::catalog scope

platforms.conclusion_vi: API popularity và lịch sử nghe có tồn tại trong tài liệu chính thức nhưng yêu cầu OAuth, x-api-key và quyền closed beta. Lịch sử cá nhân không phải số liệu toàn nền tảng; chart cadence chưa rõ.

evidence.facts: Public Top Anghami page contains 50 songs. Its own description identifies them as most-streamed songs and states daily updates. Web research could read it; central runner accessibility remains separate evidence.
Official help describes daily and weekly chart updates.

Live Radio supports live music sessions, comments, applause and chats, with public or private sessions. Plus is required to host; Free and Plus users can join. The help page explicitly says it is unavailable on PC/Web. No documented public crawl/API feed was identified here.
Public home page includes a new-music section and links to music entities. Catalog publication latency is not stated.
